assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, coverage, setbacks, road redlines, parking, utilities and engineering constraints are not available in cleared official materials.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, massing, transport and utility proposals remain conceptual interfaces rather than statutory or engineering conclusions.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are repository provisional geometries fitted to announced text and approximate areas.
assumptions.impact: All derived maps and area metrics must be regenerated when official polygons are released.

assumptions.statement: No cleared building survey, structural condition, use, age or ownership dataset is available.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints represent reversible module envelopes; no real building is designated for demolition.

assumptions.statement: Cleared heritage protection and construction-control polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and public-space elements remain non-contact, reversible concepts pending heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Official road sections, station interfaces, pedestrian counts and kerb/parking baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Cross-links express survey priorities and must not be interpreted as road or bridge alignments.

assumptions.statement: Project-area public-facility capacity and demographic baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Service locations and capacity are directional; no facility quota or eligibility promise is made.

assumptions.statement: The Slow Variables Council, Clock Contract and annual events are proposed operating mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent confirmed government organisation, funding, procurement or partnerships.
